scope: ClassicF41196MHz, provisional for production until both CPU integrations validated

native.reason: Near best long-search throughput with the first-byte and n==1 paths; data SRAM and Flash both measured

standalone.reason: Local fallback preserves the fast first-byte and n==1 paths; old26-slot hosts remain supported

shared.provider: optional publicmemchr slot26 only when services>=32/count>=27
shared.reason: Actual Flash resident faster than local SRAM on long scans; raw short-call overhead is retained

caveats: No single body wins every tested length/alignment/hit position
pair64 is about0.08percent faster than balanced64 for aligned4096-byte SRAM data and about3.5percent for Flash data in a local SRAM APP, but n1absent costs22cycles instead of14
This does not select M0 or claim F401 hardware timings
F401 final body must respect its separate4KiB headroom gate
